name: slide_index2_chr
title: Index slide along two vectors, as strings.

origin.description: Index slide along two vectors, as strings.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The vector or list of vectors to slide over.

arguments.name: .f
arguments.text: A function applied to each window. A formula is accepted in R.

arguments.name: .before / .after
arguments.text: How far the window reaches. Inf pins that edge. A negative value looks the other way.

arguments.name: .step / .complete
arguments.text: step skips positions. complete leaves a partial window missing.

origin.details: Index slide along two vectors, as strings. Positions the step or the complete flag skips stay missing. An empty window is a zero-length slice.
origin.value: A vector the same length as the input, or the length of the hop ranges.
origin.example: slide_index2_chr(ch, ch, i, function(a, b) paste(a, collapse = ""), .before = 2)

translation.description: Index slide along two vectors, as strings.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The vector or list of vectors. A NumPy array is accepted.

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: A function applied to each window. It receives the window as a list.

arguments.name: before / after
arguments.text: How far the window reaches. math.inf pins that edge.

arguments.name: step / complete
arguments.text: step skips positions. complete leaves a partial window missing.

translation.details: Index slide along two vectors, as strings. Numeric summaries use the fanout-16 segment tree and NumPy long double.
translation.value: A list. Missing doubles are NaN. Missing integers, logicals, and strings are None.
translation.example:
from slider import slide_index2_chr
return slide_index2_chr(ch, ch, i, lambda a, b: "".join(a), before=2)
